# PaleoSpec

PaleoSpec is an R package to assist in the spectral analysis of
timeseries, in particular timeseries of climate variables from
observational, model, and proxy paleoclimate data sources. PaleoSpec
contains functions to analyse existing timeseries and to generate
timeseries with specific spectral properties.

## Installation

You can install the development version of PaleoSpec from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("EarthSystemDiagnostics/paleospec")
```

Please refer to function references here:
<https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/index.html>

## Usage

### Estimating power spectra

`SpecMTM` can be used to estimate the power spectrum of a timeseries
using the multitaper method.

Here we estimate the spectrum of the monthly sunspot data that comes
with R. The sunspot data are already a timeseries object so SpecMTM
knows the correct frequency of the observations. We can plot the power
spectrum with the PaleoSpec function LPlot.

``` r

sunspot <- datasets::sunspot.month
plot(sunspot)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-3-1.png)

``` r

library(PaleoSpec)
sp_sun <- SpecMTM(sunspot)
LPlot(sp_sun)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-4-1.png)

Alternatively we can use the gg_spec() function to get a ggplot2

``` r

gg_spec(sp_sun)
#> Scale for colour is already present.
#> Adding another scale for colour, which will replace the existing scale.
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-5-1.png)

Appproximate confidence intervals can be added with the function
AddConfInterval()

``` r

sp_sun <- AddConfInterval(sp_sun)
gg_spec(sp_sun)
#> Scale for colour is already present.
#> Adding another scale for colour, which will replace the existing scale.
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-6-1.png)

### Simulating timeseries with given spectral properties

`SimPLS` can be used to create a timeseries whose power spectrum has
powerlaw like properties, where: $`S(f) = \alpha f^{-\beta}`$

``` r

# setting the seed of the random number generator so that this example will 
# always generate the same time series
set.seed(20221109)

# length of the time series
N <- 1e03

# parameters of the powerlaw spectrum
alpha <- 0.1
beta <- 1

ts1 <- SimPLS(N = N, b = beta, a = alpha)
plot(ts1, type = "l")
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-7-1.png)

`SpecMTM` can again be used to estimate the power spectrum using the
multitaper method. If we convert the vector from SimPLS to a timeseries
object, and add information about the sampling frequency of the
timeseries then SpecMTM will have the correct frequency axis.

``` r

sp1 <- SpecMTM(ts(ts1, deltat = 1))

LPlot(sp1)
abline(log10(alpha), -beta, col = "red")
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-8-1.png)

You can add confidence intervals to the spectral estimates with
`AddConfInterval`

``` r

sp1 <- AddConfInterval(sp1)
LPlot(sp1)
abline(log10(alpha), -beta, col = "red")
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-9-1.png)

The `LogSmooth` function can be used to smooth power spectra with
equally spaced filter in log-space.

``` r

sp1_f <- LogSmooth(sp1, df.log = 0.01)
LPlot(sp1)
LLines(sp1_f, col = "green")
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-10-1.png)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`AddConfInterval()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/AddConfInterval.md)
  : Add confidence interval
- [`AnPowerlaw()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/AnPowerlaw.md)
  : A PSD(freq) for a powerlaw with variance 1
- [`ApplyFilter()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/ApplyFilter.md)
  : Filter time series
- [`ApproxNearest()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/ApproxNearest.md)
  : approximate a timeseries using the nearest neighbour
- [`AvgToBin()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/AvgToBin.md)
  : Bin averaging
- [`Bandpass()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/Bandpass.md)
  : Calculate Weights for a Bandpass Filter
- [`BinTimeseries()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/BinTimeseries.md)
  : Bin a Timeseries Preserving Empty Bins
- [`ClosestElement()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/ClosestElement.md)
  : Get closest element of a vector
- [`ColTransparent()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/ColTransparent.md)
  : Modify a color to get brighter and tranparent for the confidence
  intervals
- [`ConfRatio()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/ConfRatio.md)
  : Confidence Interval of ratios
- [`ConfVar()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/ConfVar.md)
  : Provide ChiSquared confidence intervals for ratios
- [`DF2Spec()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/DF2Spec.md)
  : Transform a spec_df Object into a spec Object or List of spec
  Objects
- [`FilterSpec()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/FilterSpec.md)
  : Filter a Power Spectrum Object
- [`FilterSpecLog()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/FilterSpecLog.md)
  : Smooth a Spectrum with Evenly Spaced Bins in Logspace
- [`FirstElement()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/FirstElement.md)
  : first element of a vector
- [`GetTransferFunction()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/GetTransferFunction.md)
  : Derives and plots the transfer function (given a filter)
- [`GetVarFromSpectra()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/GetVarFromSpectra.md)
  : Variance estimate by integrating a part of the spectrum
- [`Highpass()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/Highpass.md)
  : calculate weights for a bandpass filter
- [`InverseFilter()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/InverseFilter.md)
  : Construct the inverse filter in the time domain
- [`LLines()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/LLines.md)
  : Add a spectrum to an existing log-log spectral plot.
- [`LPlot()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/LPlot.md)
  : Log-log spectral plot.
- [`LastElement()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/LastElement.md)
  : last element of a vector
- [`LogSmooth()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/LogSmooth.md)
  : Smooths the spectrum using a log smoother
- [`Lowpass()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/Lowpass.md)
  : Calculate weights for lowpass filter
- [`MakeEquidistant()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/MakeEquidistant.md)
  : Average an irregular timeseries to a regular timeseries
- [`MeanSpectrum()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/MeanSpectrum.md)
  : Weighted mean spectrum
- [`MonthlyFromDaily()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/MonthlyFromDaily.md)
  : Bin daily values to monthly values
- [`NaFillTs()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/NaFillTs.md)
  : NaFill
- [`PS.VarUntilF()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/PS.VarUntilF.md)
  : Variance of a powerlaw process if integrated from until frequency f
- [`PSP.CorAfterRollmean()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/PSP.CorAfterRollmean.md)
  : Numerical correlation of random timeseries with different filtering
  (running mean)
- [`PSP.CorUntilF()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/PSP.CorUntilF.md)
  : lowpass filtered expected correlation of powerlaw signal pair
- [`SimFromEmpiricalSpec()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/SimFromEmpiricalSpec.md)
  : Simulate a random timeseries consistent with an arbitrary numerical
  power spectrum
- [`SimPLS()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/SimPLS.md)
  : Simulate a random timeseries with a powerlaw spectrum
- [`SimPowerlaw()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/SimPowerlaw.md)
  : Simulate a random timeseries with a powerlaw spectrum
- [`SimPowerlawPiecewise()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/SimPowerlawPiecewise.md)
  : Simulate a timeseries with length N which has a spectra consisting
  of two powerlaws
- [`SimProxySeries()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/SimProxySeries.md)
  [`sim.proxy.series()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/SimProxySeries.md)
  : Simulate a Proxy Time Series Assuming a Power-Law Power Spectrum of
  the Climate
- [`SimulatePowerlawSignalPair()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/SimulatePowerlawSignalPair.md)
  : Create a pair of random signals with powerlaw signal and powerlaw
  noise
- [`SlopeFit()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/SlopeFit.md)
  : Fit a power-law to the spectrum
- [`Spec2DF()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/Spec2DF.md)
  : Transform Spec Object(s) Into a Dataframe
- [`SpecACF()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/SpecACF.md)
  : Estimate Power Spectra via the Autocovariance Function With Optional
  Slepian Tapers
- [`SpecInterpolate()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/SpecInterpolate.md)
  : Interpolate spectrum
- [`SpecMTM()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/SpecMTM.md)
  : MTM spectral estimator
- [`SubsampleTimeseriesBlock()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/SubsampleTimeseriesBlock.md)
  : Subsample (downsample) timeseries using block averaging#'
- [`TrimNA()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/TrimNA.md)
  : Remove leading and trailing rows of all NA
- [`as.data.frame(`*`<spec>`*`)`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/as.data.frame.spec.md)
  : Transform a spec Object Into a Dataframe
- [`as.spec()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/as.spec.md)
  : Make a spec Object
- [`as_spec_df()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/as_spec_df.md)
  : Make a spec_df Object
- [`gg_spec()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/gg_spec.md)
  : Plot One or More Spectra with ggplot2
- [`is.spectrum()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/is.spectrum.md)
  : Check for spectral object
- [`remove.highestFreq()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/remove.highestFreq.md)
  : Remove high frequencies
- [`remove.lowestFreq()`](https://earthsystemdiagnostics.github.io/paleospec/reference/remove.lowestFreq.md)
  : Remove low frequencies
